_README: The portal agent answers application forms ONLY from this file. Anything set
to null is treated as 'I do not know' and the agent will refuse to guess - it
flags the application for you instead of inventing an answer.
Fill in the nulls below and far more applications will go through untouched.
security_clearance: None currently held. Previously held during Royal Navy service; lapsed since discharge. Eligible to be put through vetting.
degree: BEng (Hons) Engineering: Instrumentation, Measurement & Control (year 1 completed, paused)
school_qualifications: SQA Diploma in Engineering; NC Electrical Engineering (SCQF 6); SVQ Level 2 Performing Engineering Operations; Scottish Highers
_never_auto_filled: Anything in this list is refused by code even if you put a value here, because
getting it wrong on your behalf is worse than a flagged application:
national insurance number, passport number, bank or sort code details,
date of birth, criminal convictions, DBS, medical or health questions,
ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability status.
Those forms get filled to the last safe field and then handed to you.
